title: 08. Multi-Agent & Patterns: RETRIEVAL (Online — Every Request)
summary: RETRIEVAL (Online — Every Request): explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
USER QUERY: "Can I get a refund after 30 days?"
               │
               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│      QUERY PROCESSING            │
│                                  │
│  1. Query rewriting (optional)   │
│     "refund after 30 days"       │
│     → "refund policy time limit" │
│     → "return window duration"   │
│     (expand to catch more docs)  │
│                                  │
│  2. Query embedding              │
│     → [0.21, -0.44, 0.85, ...]  │
└──────────────┬───────────────────┘
               │
               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│      RETRIEVER                   │
│                                  │
│  OPTION A: Dense Retrieval       │
│  (Vector similarity search)      │
│  Fast, semantic understanding    │
│                                  │
│  OPTION B: Sparse Retrieval      │
│  (BM25 keyword search)           │
│  Exact keyword matching          │
│                                  │
│  OPTION C: Hybrid (Production!)  │
│  Dense + Sparse → combine scores │
│  Best of both worlds             │
└──────────────┬───────────────────┘
               │
               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│      RAW RESULTS                 │
│                                  │
│  Chunk 1: "Refunds allowed..."   │ score: 0.91
│  Chunk 5: "30-day window..."     │ score: 0.87
│  Chunk 2: "Policy exceptions..." │ score: 0.79
│  Chunk 8: "Contact support..."   │ score: 0.71
│  ... (top-20 candidates)         │
└──────────────┬───────────────────┘
               │
               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│      RE-RANKER                   │
│  Cross-encoder model             │
│  Re-scores: query ↔ each chunk   │
│  Much more accurate than         │
│  embedding similarity alone      │
│                                  │
│  After re-ranking:               │
│  Chunk 5: "30-day window..."     │ score: 0.94
│  Chunk 1: "Refunds allowed..."   │ score: 0.89
│  Chunk 2: "Policy exceptions..." │ score: 0.82
└──────────────┬───────────────────┘
               │
               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│      CONTEXT BUILDER             │
│  Assemble top chunks into        │
│  coherent context for LLM        │
│                                  │
│  Apply token budget:             │
│  Max 2000 tokens for context     │
│  Take top chunks until full      │
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```
